name: andes-documents
description: Andes-branded Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files as on-demand skills: the Andes logo in every format, the Andes palette with accessible chart colors, Office-safe fonts, and embedded brand fonts in PDFs, plus reading, editing, and PDF operations, and andes-document-designer, an agent that builds each format and reviews every rendered page or slide. Requires Python 3.9+, Node.js 18+ for Word and PowerPoint, and LibreOffice for page renders; packages install only when you approve.
